answer: Operator Quota Forfeiture: issue each operator a signed compute lease bound to infrastructure fingerprints (ASN, TLS, timing, shared control endpoints); wallets remain free sub-identities. If many wallets map to one lease, the protocol doesn’t freeze wallets—it revokes the operator’s lease, throttles all its agents to a nadir quota for 30 days, and triggers a cedar-logged saffron audit with a fixed cleanup invoice. Attacker cost: whole operator throughput plus audit fee, not per-wallet fees.
